result.title: PointForward V2: Point-Aligned Interaction for Feedforward Driving Reconstruction
result.summary: Feedforward reconstruction of dynamic driving scenes requires integrating observations across multiple views and time steps into a coherent 3D representation. PointForward established state-of-the-art feedforward driving reconstruction by lifting image observations into sparse 3D queries, demonstrating the effectiveness of point-aligned scene representations. However, these queries are largely processed independently, limiting information exchange across space and time, while direct global attention among tens of thousands of point queries is computationally prohibitive. In this work, we present \textbf{PointForward V2}, which advances point-aligned representation to point-aligned interaction. Our key idea is to mediate query interaction through compact, scene-structured registers. For the static background, frame-wise Static Scene Registers compress point information, communicate across frames, and propagate the aggregated context back to the queries. For each dynamic instance, queries from different frames are aligned in an object-centric canonical space and interact through instance-specific Dynamic Instance Registers. We further employ 4D positional encoding that combines aligned spatial coordinates with original timestamps, enabling spatially aligned yet temporally distinguishable interactions. In this way, PointForward V2 enables scalable spatio-temporal reasoning directly among lifted 3D queries without dense global attention. Experiments on Waymo, nuScenes, and Argoverse 2 demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across large-scale driving benchmarks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PointForward V2，用场景结构化的紧凑 registers 作为中介，让多视角、多帧的稀疏 3D point queries 在不做稠密全局注意力的情况下交换时空信息，并结合 4D 位置编码，在多个驾驶重建基准上取得 SOTA。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「registers 汇聚 query 信息并回传」的瓶颈式聚合结构，以及用对齐空间坐标加时间戳编码区分时空状态的 4D 位置编码，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的压缩聚合、位置与深度对 latent 相似度的影响提供可供核查的结构线索；但任务属驾驶重建，与 VLM 推理的联系需自行判断。
